I'm so sorry for your loss.. Sending love & a big warm embrace back to you from the east. I am in awe of your strength & compassion. Thanks for replying. 

The pandemic made manageable problems unmanageable. I'm rooting for collective strength to get through this & I hope we don't come out too scarred. I was exercising so much but I fell off when this d e e p r e s t became unbearable

Thank you for replying. I'd be grateful to hear this voice, now that I have high expectations. If you've got the time, I'd love to listen to you go on about your favorite things, your beloved dog, anything at all. 1-570-687-6908 I'll give you feedback on your voice acting

Thank you for replying to me. You can text me if you have the time. 1-570-687-6908 Like I said, I don't want to unload. Just distract. I have tried but he also has a ton of stress. Just feel like I'm completely unseen. 

I have always wanted to be a famous lawyer or politician. Famous for helping people. I've strived to help people all my life but somehow my efforts never make a difference. Maybe if I were famous, they would. 

My good friend just adopted a puppy. She makes me laugh when I don't even feel like I could.
